result.question: What did the man of God do after speaking with the king?

readings.answer: He went another way instead of returning by the way he came to Bethel.
readings.support: So the man of God went another way and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel.

assessments.reason: The reading paraphrases v.10 exactly: he went another way and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel.

result.reason: Verse 10 directly answers that he went another way and did not return by his original route, matching the key.
